# GaitStyleOverride

Kind: context · Defined in [`src/logic/animals/gait.h`](../../../src/logic/animals/gait.h) · Described in `data/animals.json`

When on, every animal walks with this style (the debug menu).

## Fields

| Field | Type | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `on` | `bool` | Override active. |
| `style` | `GaitStyle` | The style forced on every AnimalGait. |

## Notes

Emplaced and edited by the debug menu (view/systems/debug_menu.cpp); read by AnimalGait.

## Systems that touch it

Read only by: AnimalGait. Written by: DebugMenu. Created by: DebugMenu. Destroyed by: —.

| System | Kind | Scope | Access | Where | What it does with it |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md) | system | Host | **read** | tick | Style forced on every animal while on. |
| [DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md) | system | Host | **readwrite+create** | tick | emplaced when the Animals header is drawn; "One walk for all" and the GaitStyle sliders |

## Side effects of those systems

- **[AnimalGait](../systems/AnimalGait.md)**
  - Logs one line per species and gait clip analysed.
  - Queries the ground field several times per foot per frame.
- **[DebugMenu](../systems/DebugMenu.md)**
  - One ImGui window "Dynamical" (needs UI before it).
  - Changing the soil or grass height-map parameters makes SoilMaps / GrassPass bake their per-chunk maps again (they watch RenderSettings).
  - Creates torch entities and dynamic boxes (Jolt bodies through RigidBodySys) on button presses; destroys every PointLight entity on "No torches".
